status.offline: ʻAʻole ʻoe i pili i ka pūnaewele. Hana nō ka ʻike i mālama ʻia.
status.offlineReady: Mākaukau ʻo Kōkua e hana me ka ʻole o ka pūnaewele.
status.updateAvailable: Aia kekahi mana hou o Kōkua.

i18n.unreviewed: Hōʻike ʻia kēia kuhikuhi palekana ma ka ʻōlelo Pelekānia no ka mea ʻaʻole i nānā ʻia kona unuhi.
i18n.unreviewedList: Hōʻike ʻia kēia mau mea palekana ma ka ʻōlelo Pelekānia no ka mea ʻaʻole i nānā ʻia ko lākou unuhi.
i18n.draftLanguage: He kāmua mīkini kēia unuhi, ʻaʻole i nānā ʻia e ka mānaleo. Kuhihewa paha kekahi mau huaʻōlelo.

zone.title: Aia anei au i loko o ka ʻāpana haʻalele?
zone.body: E nānā inā aia kekahi wahi i loko o ka ʻāpana haʻalele kai eʻe. Hana kēia me ka ʻole o ka pūnaewele.
zone.naturalWarningHeading: Nā hōʻailona kūlohelohe o ke kai eʻe
zone.naturalWarningSource: Kumu: Ke alakaʻi palekana kai eʻe o ka National Weather Service

places.title: Nā puʻuhonua makani pāhili
places.body: Nā puʻuhonua makani pāhili kūhelu kokoke loa ma Oʻahu, ma ka mamao pololei. Hana kēia me ka ʻole o ka pūnaewele.
places.outsideCoverage: No Oʻahu wale nō kā mākou ʻikepili puʻuhonua.

alerts.title: Nā ʻōlelo aʻo o ke ea
alerts.body: Nā ʻōlelo aʻo no Hawaiʻi mai ka National Weather Service. Mālama ʻia ke kope hope loa ma kāu kelepona, no laila hiki ke heluhelu ʻia me ka ʻole o ka hōʻailona.

plan.title: Ka papa hana pōpilikia o ka ʻohana
plan.body: E kākau i kahi e hui ai ka ʻohana a me ka mea e kelepona ai. Mālama ʻia nā mea a pau ma kēia kelepona wale nō.

safety.naturalWarning: Inā ʻike ʻoe i kekahi ōlaʻi ikaika a i ʻole ʻike ʻoe i ka mimiki ʻana o ke kai, e neʻe koke i uka a i kahi kiʻekiʻe. Mai kali i ka ʻōlelo aʻo kūhelu.
safety.inZone: Inā puka kekahi ʻōlelo aʻo kai eʻe, e haʻalele koke i kēia ʻāpana. E hele i uka a i kahi kiʻekiʻe, ma ka wāwae inā hiki.
safety.notInZone: ʻAʻole maopopo ka palekana ma waho o ka ʻāpana ma ka palapala ʻāina. E hahai mau i nā kuhikuhi a nā luna pōpilikia.
safety.placesDisclaimer: He mamao pololei nā mamao, ʻaʻole he ala kaʻa a hele wāwae paha. ʻAʻole wehe ʻia nā puʻuhonua a pau i kēlā me kēia pōpilikia, no laila e nānā i nā hoʻolaha kūhelu ma mua o ka hele ʻana.
safety.inZoneHeading: Aia ʻoe i loko o ka ʻāpana haʻalele kai eʻe
safety.inExtremeHeading: Aia ʻoe i loko o ka ʻāpana haʻalele kai eʻe nui loa
safety.inExtremeZone: E haʻalele koke i kēia ʻāpana inā puka ka Extreme Tsunami Warning, a i ʻole inā kauoha nā luna. E hele i uka a i kahi kiʻekiʻe, ma ka wāwae inā hiki.
safety.notInZoneHeading: Aia ʻoe ma waho o nā ʻāpana haʻalele kai eʻe ma ka palapala ʻāina
safety.outsideCoverageHeading: Aia kēia wahi ma waho o ka ʻāpana i uhi ʻia e kā mākou ʻikepili, no laila ʻaʻole hiki iā mākou ke haʻi aku.
safety.alertsStale: He kahiko paha kēia mau ʻōlelo aʻo. No ka mea hou loa, e hoʻolohe i ka lekiō a kīwī kūloko, a i ʻole ka NOAA Weather Radio.
safety.kitWater: Wai: {{gallons}} kālani (1 kālani no ke kanaka i kēlā me kēia lā no {{days}} lā)
safety.kitFood: Meaʻai e mau ana me ka ʻole o ka pahu hau, lawa no {{days}} lā
safety.kitMeds: Nā lāʻau lapaʻau a me nā kope o nā palapala kauoha no {{days}} lā
safety.kitRadio: Lekiō pākaukau a i ʻole wili lima
safety.kitLight: Nā kukui uila a me nā pākaukau ʻē aʻe
safety.kitPower: Nā mea hoʻouka kelepona a me ka pākaukau kākoʻo i hoʻouka piha ʻia
safety.kitDocs: Nā kope o nā palapala ʻike, ʻinikua, a me nā palapala koʻikoʻi i loko o ka ʻeke pale wai
safety.kitPets: Meaʻai, wai, a me nā lako no nā holoholona hānai
safety.kitKnowZone: E nānā inā aia kou hale, kula, a me kahi hana i loko o ka ʻāpana haʻalele kai eʻe
safety.kitOutOfArea: E koho i kekahi kanaka ma waho o ka mokupuni e hiki i ka ʻohana a pau ke kelepona aku
safety.printPlan: E paʻi i kekahi kope a mālama pū me kāu pahu lako. Pau paha ka ikehu o ke kelepona.
safety.refugeInfo: He koho hope loa nā puʻuhonua makani pāhili no ka poʻe ʻaʻohe wahi palekana aʻe. ʻAʻohe lako ma laila, no laila e lawe pū i kāu pahu lako. Inā kūkulu ʻia kou hale i ka makahiki 1995 a ma hope mai, a aia ma waho o nā wahi wai hālana a me ke kai piʻi o ka ʻino, ʻoi aku paha ka palekana o ka noho ʻana ma ka hale.
safety.tsunamiNotRefuge: No ke kai eʻe, mai hele i ka puʻuhonua. E hele i uka a i kahi kiʻekiʻe, ma waho o ka ʻāpana haʻalele.

plan.contactsBody: E hoʻokomo i kekahi kanaka ma waho o ka mokupuni. Hana pinepine nā kelepona mamao a me nā leka uila ke paʻa nā laina kūloko.

map.label: Palapala ʻāina o nā ʻāpana haʻalele. E kaomi i kekahi wahi e nānā ai.
map.loading: Ke hoʻouka nei i ka palapala ʻāina…
map.unavailable: ʻAʻole hiki ke hōʻike i ka palapala ʻāina ma kēia hāmeʻa. Hiki nō ke hoʻohana i kou wahi a i ʻole e hoʻokomo i nā kuhikuhina.
map.help: E kaomi i ka palapala ʻāina e nānā i kekahi wahi. E hoʻohana i ʻelua manamana lima e hoʻoneʻe i ka palapala ʻāina. ʻAʻole hiki ke hoʻohana i ka palapala ʻāina? E hoʻohana i kou wahi a i ʻole e hoʻokomo i nā kuhikuhina ma lalo. ʻO Oʻahu wale nō ma ka palapala ʻāina; ʻo nā mokupuni nui a pau ma nā ʻāpana.
